transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having a hard time lately. I keep... well, I keep beating myself up about work. I just feel like I'm not really senior material. Like I sort of... fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can.
How long have you been feeling this way about your work and yourself—days, weeks, or longer?

Um... probably about a month. Yeah, a month ago. They, uh... they asked me to cover the senior analyst duties at work around then. And I guess since that happened, there's just been this... I don't know, this noticeable up-and-down pattern.
Do you notice this down or anxious feeling throughout your day in general, or does it mainly come up when you're thinking about or dealing with work?

It's... pretty much all the time. Not just work. Most days lately, I just have this... I don't know, this heavy feeling. Like I'm just going through the motions at work, and at home. It's just sort of... low. Like everything's a bit muted.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you'd normally enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends and family?
Yeah, I guess so. I mean, usually I like to grill on the weekend, or maybe go fishing. Put on a record. But lately... I don't know. The stuff just sits there. I just don't really care right now.
Have you ever gone through a stretch like this before—feeling persistently low, unmotivated, and losing interest in things—at any other point in your life?

Yeah, I suppose. Um... if I really think about it, these... these kind of low stretches, where I just feel sort of guilty and down... they've been coming and going for a while. Maybe... I don't know, almost a year? About eleven months, off and on.

During that past 11 months, were there stretches of at least a couple of months where you felt completely back to your normal self, with no low mood or loss of interest at all, in between these episodes?
I... I don't really know. Um, I haven't exactly kept a calendar of it. It's hard to remember if there was ever a full couple of months like that. It just kind of blends together.
Over these past 11 months, would you say the low periods were usually pretty mild and just in the background, or have there been times as intense and all-consuming as what you're feeling right now?
I guess... maybe they've just been kind of in the background. It's hard to say. I don't think it's usually this heavy, but... yeah, mostly just mild, I suppose.
Over the past month, have you noticed any changes in your sleep—trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, a little, I guess. Um... sometimes I wake up way too early. Just... thinking about client tickets and work stuff, and then I can't really get back to sleep. Or... I don't know, even if I do get enough hours in, I still just feel pretty worn out.
Has this current level of intense, all-consuming low mood happened to you before, in the same way, at some earlier point in your life, or is this the first time it's been this severe?
I don't really know. Um... maybe? I mean, I've had times where I felt down before, but... I don't know if it was exactly like this. It's hard to remember.

Thinking back, was there ever a stretch of at least two weeks before this past month where you felt this same level of heavy, all-consuming low mood, with things like poor sleep, low energy, and guilt all together?
I don't think so. I mean, not that I can remember. Two weeks is a long time to feel... like this. So, probably not.
Over this past month, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight, or trouble concentrating on tasks at work?

Um... I guess my appetite's been a bit off. I mostly just... grab a few bites here and there. Or I'll just skip supper. I did notice my belt is a little looser lately, which is weird since I'm not actually trying to lose weight. As for work... I don't know. I'm just trying to get through the tickets.
Over this past month, have you had any thoughts of death, or that you'd be better off not being here, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Um... no. Not really. I mean, I haven't... I haven't made any kind of plan or anything like that. It's just... sometimes I think... I don't know, maybe it would just be easier if I went to sleep and didn't wake up. But I wouldn't actually do anything.
Over the past month, have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy nearly every day, even when you haven't been especially active?

Yeah... I guess I have been pretty tired. Um... by the time I get home from the office, I just... I don't have much left in the tank. Even simple things, like... checking the mail or putting a few plates in the dishwasher, it just feels like... like more effort than it should be.
